title: Efficacy of Conbercept in the Treatment of Choroidal Neovascularization Secondary to Pathologic Myopia

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA (letters) before treatment and at 1, 3 and 6 months (T2 C2)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case set (protocol inclusion 5): inclusion criterion 'a minimum follow-up period of 6 months after the first intravitreal conbercept injections' equals the last tabulated visit; the statement that all patients completed at least 6 months restates this criterion and does not say that no treated eye was left out

exclusions.what: Results-text BCVA gain categories after 1 month
exclusions.reason: Proportions of eyes are not admissible

notes: Retrospective analysis of 24 treatment-naive eyes of 20 patients with myopic CNV, intravitreal conbercept 0.5 mg as needed; BCVA measured with the ETDRS scale; values presented as mean ± SD.
